description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, QUOTATION, OR BID. NO SOLICITATION IS CURRENTLYAVAILABLE. SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE: The Government is aware of existing Air Force-approved class justificationssupporting the use of Trane HVAC chiller systems at Vandenberg SFB. This Sources Sought Notice is intended to inform anindependent USACE determination as to whether similar conditions exist for USACE-executed projects. This requirementapplies to all Vandenberg SFB projects involving HVAC chiller system installation, replacement, upgrade, or repair. TheGovernment is seeking information from industry to assist in determining the availability of capable sources and potentialalternative solutions. Responses to this notice are for planning purposes only. No proposal or contract will be awarded fromthis notice. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this notice orany follow-up information requests. Please see the attached document for more details.
